mainEntity.name: Does Privacy Score see my browsing history?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Privacy Score only reads the App Privacy Report that iOS generates itself (Apple documentation): the list of apps that accessed your sensors and the domains they contacted. Your Safari history, your messages, your photos: never touched.

mainEntity.name: So how do you make money?

acceptedAnswer.text: The app is free to download and free to use for your first complete scan, which stays accessible on your iPhone for life. To import a new report, you subscribe through Apple: €23.88 per year or €20.94 per six months. That is our only source of revenue. No advertising, no data resale, no partner pays us a commission.
Not yet. Privacy Score relies on the native iOS report, a feature Apple opened up in 2021. An Android version would depend on Google offering an equivalent.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I uninstall the app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Everything goes. The report, the score history, your preferences: it all lives inside the iOS sandbox. Apple wipes it on uninstall. No copy anywhere else.

mainEntity.name: How can I verify the app collects nothing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Privacy Score works entirely offline. You can confirm it yourself: turn on Airplane Mode and the app keeps working. And in your own iOS App Privacy Report, Privacy Score shows zero contacted domains. No server, no account, no telemetry.
